request.prompt: Create one production candidate bitmap for the Armax Relay Clash 2D fighting-game art catalog, faithfully studying the supplied original game-model reference. A single full-body subject only, isolated on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no scenery, no floor plane or ground shadow, no lettering, no caption, no border, no diagram, no contact sheet, no repeated views, no logo added outside the subject. Clean readable silhouette, detailed realistic game-model materials, restrained neutral studio illumination. Show a three-quarter front view with the subject oriented toward screen-right, camera level and minimal perspective distortion. The complete head, equipment, limbs and feet must fit; leave at least six percent transparent breathing room on every side. Preserve the reference's real anatomy, panel construction, proportions, asymmetric equipment and exact costume palette. Do not redesign or modernize. Subject: ONE Cerberus Atlas heavy piloted mech from Mass Effect 3, use the CENTER CLOSED-COCKPIT version of the supplied three-view sheet as the exact construction reference. Very broad massive squat mech with enormous circular shoulder joints and short heavy articulated legs, weathered off-white grey armor, thin mustard-yellow markings and black recessed machinery. The upper torso is a rounded AMBER/YELLOW TRANSPARENT ENCLOSED cockpit canopy with visible seated pilot only faintly seen inside as part of the cockpit; canopy closed, no hatch opened, no separate human standing beside the mech. Preserve the frontal tubular protective canopy rail, black angular center belly plate with the Cerberus emblem, tall boxy shoulder plates, split chunky thigh shells and broad flat armored feet. ANATOMICAL RIGHT arm ends in the short large tubular cannon muzzle from the reference; ANATOMICAL LEFT arm ends in the articulated claw hand. The arm systems must not be mirrored, doubled or changed to two fists. Same huge arm-to-torso and short-leg proportions as the official textured model, both feet fully on the same level, slight alert stance. No missiles, laser beams, firing, energy glow, heroic human torso, painted battle backdrop or new appendages.
